title: Resolve asynchronous API versions in registration order
summary: A gated first version resolver now wins despite a ready second resolver. When the first failed, the subscriber received that exact error and the second publisher had zero subscriptions.

change.description: Reactive version resolution now waits for the first configured resolver to produce a value, fail, or complete empty before considering a later resolver.

notes: The parent returned the later value before the gate opened. An immediately empty first resolver selected the fallback on both revisions.
